chat.title: Ask about your records
suggestedQuestions: What is my income this week?
How much did I spend this week?
What is my highest expense category this week?
How much do I have in outstanding receivables?
chat.weeklyIncomeAnswer: This week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}), recorded income is {{amount}} MMK.
chat.weeklyExpensesAnswer: This week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}), recorded expenses are {{amount}} MMK.
chat.weeklyCategoryAnswer: This week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}), your highest expense category is {{category}} at {{amount}} MMK.
chat.noWeeklyTransactionsAnswer: There are no settled expenses this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}).
chat.noWeeklyIncomeAnswer: There is no settled income this week ({{startDate}} to {{endDate}}).
chat.receivablesAnswer: You have {{amount}} MMK in {{count}} unpaid receivable(s).
chat.description: A rule-based demo grounded in records saved in this browser.
chat.limits: Rule-based demo only. Answers use records currently saved in this browser. Unsupported questions and requests for financial, legal or tax advice are declined.
chat.questionPlaceholder: For example: What do I owe?
chat.unsupportedAnswer: I can answer questions about recorded totals, expenses, categories, owed payments, overdue items, and document checklist status. I can't provide projections, predict loan approval, or give financial, legal, or tax advice.
chat.documentsAnswer: You marked {{completed}} of {{total}} supporting document checklist items as available.
chat.overdueAnswer: {{count}} unpaid item(s) are overdue, totaling {{amount}} MMK.
chat.outstandingAnswer: You have {{receivable}} MMK in unpaid incoming payments and {{payable}} MMK in unpaid obligations.
chat.topExpenseAnswer: Your largest settled expense this month is {{amount}} MMK.
chat.categoryAnswer: The largest expense category this month is {{category}} at {{amount}} MMK.
chat.periodAnswer: This month, recorded settled income is {{income}} MMK and expenses are {{expenses}} MMK, for net movement of {{net}} MMK.
chat.noTransactionsAnswer: There are no matching settled records for this period.
